data.gender_notes: Faryad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: An Arabic and Persian name meaning 'cry for help' or 'supplication'. It is gender-neutral and widely used in Islamic culture. The name Faryad carries the meaning “Cry for help” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faryad usually hope their child will grow to embody cry for help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Faryad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cry for help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faryad total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فرياد
in_arabic.meaning: صوت عال و بلند، فریاد، ندا، آواز بلند
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فرياد مشتق من الفعل فارى و هو الفعل الذى يدل على الصوت العال و المتكرر، و معناه فى اللغة العربية صوت عال و بلند، فریاد، ندا، آواز بلند، و قد ورد فى بعض الآثار النبوية أن النبى صلى الله عليه و سلم كان إذا دعا الله تعالى رفع صوته و قال فرياد

in_urdu.name: فریاد
in_urdu.meaning: بلند آواز، فریاد، ندا، آواز بلند
in_urdu.long_meaning: فریاد ایک اسم ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل فارى سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند آواز یا فریاد، اور یہ اللہ تعالیٰ سے دعا مانگنے کے وقت بلند آواز سے پکارنے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: फरियाद
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च स्वर, फरियाद, पुकार, ऊंची आवाज
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरियाद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्च स्वर या फरियाद, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है और अक्सर इसे आध्यात्मिक महत्व के साथ जोड़ा जाता है

in_pashto.name: فریاد
in_pashto.meaning: لوړ غږ، فریاد، نده، لوړه آوازه
in_pashto.long_meaning: فریاد دى يو نوم چې د عربي ژبې د فعل فارى څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې مانا یې لوړ غږ یا فریاد دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کېږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Faryad reflects the idea of seeking help or support from a higher power or community when facing a difficult situation. In many Islamic countries, it is common practice to call out for help in times of need with a cry or a loud call, resembling the name's literal meaning. This can be a powerful reminder of the importance of community and seeking support and protection under the watch of Allah (God).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Faryad carries a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, representing the notion of turning to Allah for guidance, help, and support during moments of crisis, uncertainty, or hardship. It is a reminder of the faith and trust in their belief in the power of Allah, and the importance of seeking His mercy and assistance through supplication and prayer. Faryad also serves as a reminder that faith and trust lie in seeking help from Allah, rather than relying on worldly solutions or resources, ultimately emphasizing the importance of spiritual connection and faith in one's daily life.
